l.i: Nemo latet, sed literulis qui jungere novit
Et compilatus post tibi cento venit.
Sic liber efformat librum nec desinit alter
Vendere pro scriptis altera scripta suis.
Non omnes hæc culpa tenet, nec scribere prorsus
Est vanum, si vis scribere, scribe nova.
Quæ nosti ingeniis trivialibus abdita scribe
Sic Otthi Praclare facis, tu Codice promis
Talmudi via strata patet, novisse docetur,

page.notes: The first letter "A" of "Annorum" is a large woodcut initial, joined to the word as "ANnorum" in print. Word "commune" carries a small inked mark over "commune". Some stains and show-through are present and were left out. Two-word ornament band at top is decorative, not transcribed. Uncertain: "Praclare" and "Otthi" as printed.
